NETWORK.NAME: AcuteDystonia_F4_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest
gate=encounter.kind == followup AND acute_dystonia effect status == present; absent yields not_applicable, not_assessed or missing yields needs_clarification

airway_rule=AirwayConcern present or breathing/stridor severity fires a deterministic urgent flag from saved inputs without waiting for any model output; do not delay airway evaluation to complete a diagnostic checklist

cdss_restriction=STATEMENT-11 Quality Measurement Considerations states this statement is not appropriate for electronic clinical decision support or quality measurement; scope resolution requested in review Q5
fr14_note=no dose, unit, route, frequency, or active/stopped fields are collected; regimen review records feasibility only

VARIABLE.NAME: DystoniaInvolvementSeverity
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Dystonia involvement severity (current, clinician-rated)

definition=Clinician rating of current dystonic involvement: without speech/swallowing/breathing involvement, with speech or swallowing involvement, or with breathing difficulty/stridor. Meaningful only when the follow-up effect status is present; present requires one of these severities.
source=history-effects-v0.1-draft acute_dystonia severity (awaiting_review) + docs/medical-docs/acute-dystonia-criteria.md Urgency and documentation
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AirwayConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Airway concern (current, clinician-assessed)

definition=Clinician-observed or suspected airway compromise, including possible laryngeal dystonia. Present when breathing difficulty/stridor severity is recorded or the proposed airway field records concern; assessed absence requires both. Absence requires assessment; this is not a diagnosis of laryngospasm.
source=BN-11 AirwayConcern lead + acute-dystonia-criteria.md Urgency and documentation + STATEMENT-11 Implementation (laryngospasm paragraph)
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Acute dystonia episode phase (current assessment with recent linkage)

definition=Current episode active, recent episode clinically resolved and under prevention review in this encounter, or phase not yet recorded. The effect status present documents the index episode in the review window; NoEpisode from BN-11 is folded into the gate (absent yields not_applicable). Proposed interpretation for review.
source=BN-11 AcuteDystoniaEpisodePhase lead (Active/Resolved/NoEpisode); NoEpisode folded into gate, unknown added
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticAssociation
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Antipsychotic association of the episode (clinician-assessed)

definition=Clinician assessment of association of the index episode with antipsychotic therapy, considering onset timing, medication review (including dopamine-blocking antiemetics and preventive anticholinergic changes), and differential exclusions. Unknown added to the BN-11 pair for missingness; never inferred from severity or medication presence.
source=BN-11 AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticAssociation lead + acute-dystonia-criteria.md Clinical assessment and exclusions
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AnticholinergicSafetyConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Patient-specific anticholinergic safety concern

definition=Clinician identifies patient-specific anticholinergic adverse effects or susceptibility needing review (cognitive, urinary, bowel, ocular, cardiac, thermoregulatory). Specifics preserved; no blanket exclusion invented. Unknown added for missingness.
source=BN-11 AnticholinergicSafetyConcern lead + STATEMENT-11 Harms
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: OlderAgeVulnerability
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Older-age vulnerability (clinician-assessed)
definition=Clinician-assessed age-related vulnerability to anticholinergic harms, without an invented numeric age threshold. Unknown added for missingness.
source=BN-11 OlderAgeVulnerability lead + STATEMENT-11 Harms (harms greater in older individuals)
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: OtherAnticholinergicBurden
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Concomitant anticholinergic burden of concern

definition=Clinician-reviewed concomitant anticholinergic exposure of concern (including antipsychotics, antidepressants, urological drugs, antihistamines); no invented burden-score cutoff. Unknown added for missingness.
source=BN-11 OtherAnticholinergicBurden lead + STATEMENT-11 Harms (augmented with other anticholinergic medications)
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: RecurrencePreventionNeed
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Recurrence-prevention need after resolution

definition=After resolution, clinician assesses an ongoing need to consider recurrence prevention while the causative regimen is reviewed; not a measured recurrence probability. Unknown added for missingness.
source=BN-11 RecurrencePreventionNeed lead + STATEMENT-11 Implementation (continue oral anticholinergic until regimen changes)
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AnticholinergicContinuationPreferenceConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Patient concern about continued anticholinergic treatment
definition=An assessed patient concern or preference against continued anticholinergic treatment. Absence does not establish consent. Unknown added for missingness.
source=BN-11 AnticholinergicContinuationPreferenceConcern lead + STATEMENT-11 Patient Preferences
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Acute dystonia review pathway (review prompt, never an order)

definition=Proposed review priority: urgent airway assessment, acute anticholinergic treatment review, episode/differential assessment, post-resolution review, or no acute treatment rule. Never an administration order, detention action, or declaration of safety.
source=BN-11 AcuteDystoniaReviewPathway lead (5 states retained verbatim); deterministic 0/1 table replaced with soft placeholders
status=proposed_review_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AnticholinergicSafetyReviewFocus
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Anticholinergic safety review focus (parallel review prompt)
definition=Parallel safety review focus. Routine individualized review does not certify treatment safety.
source=BN-11 AnticholinergicSafetyReviewFocus lead (4 states retained verbatim); deterministic 0/1 table replaced
status=proposed_review_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AcuteDystoniaAnticholinergicContinuationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Post-resolution continuation review (review prompt)
definition=Post-resolution review of short-term prevention, need, concerns, and stopping unneeded continuation. Not routine prophylaxis and not an instruction to discontinue.
source=BN-11 AcuteDystoniaAnticholinergicContinuationReview lead (5 states retained verbatim); deterministic 0/1 table replaced
status=proposed_review_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticRegimenReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Antipsychotic regimen review (review prompt)
definition=Review of possible dose reduction or a lower-risk alternative after a relevant episode; never delays acute management and records no dose, product, or threshold.
source=BN-11 AcuteDystoniaAntipsychoticRegimenReview lead (3 states retained verbatim); deterministic 0/1 table replaced
status=proposed_review_output_for_review
